newsitem.title: CHINA: China Hai'er '96 sales top $723 mln.
newsitem.headline: China Hai'er '96 sales top $723 mln.

text.p: Sales of China's Qingdao Hai'er Refrigerator Co Ltd topped 6.0 billion yuan ($723 million) in 1996, the Economic Information Daily said on Monday.

The appliance-maker clinched $115 million in export deals at a trade fair in the southern city of Guangzhou last year, the newspaper said. It did not give the total value of export deals for all of 1996.
Hai'er was the largest conglomerate in Qingdao, capital of the eastern province of Shandong, it said.
Hai'er had opened 18 retail outlets overseas and its products were sold in more than 5,700 shops across China, it said but gave no further details.
